name: Memorial Day
proprietor_take: Some men gave everything so you could have a standard worth keeping. Remember that today.

name: Father's Day
proprietor_take: He carried it every day without making a thing of it. You learned the standard by watching. That's the inheritance.

name: Independence Day
proprietor_take: Built by men who maintained everything at the highest standard. The country. The family. The work. The foundation.

name: Labor Day
proprietor_take: The man who built something worth celebrating doesn't need a day to know what the work cost. He knows.

name: Veterans Day
proprietor_take: The standard they kept wasn't grooming. But the principle is the same. Everything maintained. Nothing left to chance.

name: Thanksgiving
proprietor_take: The man who maintains everything shows up for the people who matter. Every time. That's the standard.

name: Christmas
proprietor_take: The gift that lands is the one chosen with the same care he applies to everything else. The standard doesn't take holidays.

name: New Year
proprietor_take: He doesn't wait for January to raise the standard. But January is as good a time as any to close the gaps.

name: Valentine's Day
proprietor_take: The man who takes care of himself takes care of the people he loves. The standard is not negotiable on either front.

name: St. Patrick's Day
proprietor_take: Some evenings have a name. The Saturday bottle knows what to do with them.

name: Halloween
proprietor_take: One night a year men pretend to be someone else. The Proprietor does not participate.
